grain: one row per coupon_code, catalog-wide (every code ever defined in coupon_rules, whether or not it was ever used)

coupon_rule_count.business_definition: Number of distinct coupon_rule_id records that were ever defined using this coupon_code.
coupon_rule_count.formula: count(distinct coupon_rules.coupon_rule_id where coupon_rules.coupon_code == this code)
caveats: coupon_code is NOT unique across coupon_rules -- the same code string can be reused by more than one coupon_rule_id (e.g. across different campaigns/time windows). This field reports that reuse directly rather than silently picking one rule's discount_type/discount_value to display.

currently_valid_rule_count.business_definition: Of the coupon_rule(s) using this code, how many have a [valid_from, valid_to] window that contains as_of_date.
currently_valid_rule_count.formula: count(coupon_rules where coupon_code == this code and valid_from <= as_of_date <= valid_to)

offers_created.business_definition: Number of prequalification offers that used this coupon_code, as of as_of_date.
offers_created.formula: count(prequal_offers where coupon_code == this code and created_at <= as_of_date)

applications_submitted.business_definition: Number of applications whose originating prequalification offer used this coupon_code.
applications_submitted.formula: count(applications joined to prequal_offers on offer_id where prequal_offers.coupon_code == this code)

loans_funded.business_definition: Number of funded loans whose originating application traces back (via its offer) to this coupon_code.
loans_funded.formula: count(loans joined to applications on application_id, joined to prequal_offers on offer_id, where prequal_offers.coupon_code == this code)

redemption_rate.business_definition: Share of offers using this coupon_code that ultimately funded a loan.
caveats: null (not 0.0) when this code was never used in any offer -- distinguishes 'never offered' from 'offered but never redeemed'.
